The breakdown of revenue of ¥36,616 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is: by industry, ¥19,538 million for the private sector and ¥17,077 million for the public sector; by product and service, ¥16,672 million for system development, ¥12,685 million for operation, ¥5,014 million for system maintenance, ¥672 million for information equipment sales, and ¥1,571 million for other. entries.19be4386cbcbb1bf: Under its management philosophy, it launched a new “2028 Medium-Term Management Plan” from fiscal 2026, setting out three pillars of business strategy: “Regional DX Strategy,” “Local Government Package Strategy,” and “Solution Business Strategy.” Under the Regional DX Strategy, it will promote IT consulting and solution provision starting from the welfare field; under the Local Government Package Strategy, it will position the next-generation version of WebRings, its main solution, among others, as a growth driver; and under the Solution Business Strategy, it says it will shift from a model centered on contract development to one providing solutions based on its own expertise. It also says it will work on strengthening its business foundation using AI and on sustainable management.

entries.82187fa12afb6d64: In the current consolidated fiscal year, as the second year of the “2026 Medium-Term Management Plan,” the company pursued its business mainly along three pillars: responding to the standardization of local government systems, developing next-generation solutions, and expanding its business foundation. It completed development of the local government administrative system “WebRings,” which complies with standards set by the national government, and customers have been starting to use it in sequence since January 2026. It is also advancing development of the next-generation version of WebRings, and research and development of solutions using AI technology, as well as their implementation in each solution.
